prompt: Image 1 is OUR stadium: copy its SCALE and architecture, not its composition: a gigantic 110,000-seat bowl, three tall steeply stacked decks of stands rising far above the pitch, a huge roof ring and a ring of floodlights, the players tiny against it, the stands packed to the last seat with tiny block fans. The stands show only plain club COLOURS (red-and-white sectors on one side, blue on the other), plain flat colour blocks, NEVER a crest, logo, emblem, lettering or mosaic picture. Image 2 is the CHARACTER and LOOK style: premium low-poly diorama game art, flat-shaded faceted polygons, chunky BLOCK people with box torso, box arms and legs, blocky hands and feet. Copy that look, not its composition. HEADS: every character has a ROUND head, a smooth faceted low-poly SPHERE (never a cube, never a flat disc, never bald), with low-poly HAIR on it in varied short cuts and colours (black, brown, blond, ginger, buzz cut, side parting, curls, one with a cap), and a simple low-poly face on the front of the head (two dot eyes, a nose bump, a small smile). Generic anonymous people. Everything faceted and flat-shaded, soft ambient occlusion, floodlight beams and light haze, teal-and-gold night colour grade, crisp clean render, NOT a photograph, NOT realistic. Vertical 9:16 frame. One team in plain red-and-white kits, the other in plain blue kits. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO crests, NO badges, NO signage, NO advertising boards, NO screens anywhere. Keep the top fifth of the frame clean and uncluttered. Images 3 to 7 are five profile pictures of five real-looking friends sitting around the viewer. Remake EACH of them as one of our low-poly blocky 3D characters, clearly the SAME person: same hair colour and cut, same cap / beard / glasses / scarf colours, same clothes colours. Scene: first-person view from a seat in the packed lower deck of the huge stadium looking down across the pitch, in the foreground the backs and three-quarter sides of the five neighbour fans, round faceted heads with their hair, arms up cheering with red-and-white scarves raised: the cap guy (image 3) and the girl with long hair (image 4) on the left, the bearded guy (image 5) at the right front, the blond guy (image 6) behind him and the guy with glasses and curly hair (image 7) behind on the left; the centre of the frame open onto the floodlit pitch with tiny players far below and the colossal three-deck stadium of image 1 rising around, floodlight ring, haze.
